# requirements.txt - exact versions of the environment that produced the reported numbers.
# Written from the installed environment by the collection script of the working project; do not edit by hand.
#
# Python 3.13.5
# Platform macOS-27.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O / arm64
#
# The versions below are those of the local machine. The 5-fold x 5-repeat results of PLSR, SVR, FPLR and
# FPCR in Table 2 and the reference results in 25nested_cv.csv were produced on it; they are the basis of
# the bit-for-bit reproduction check.
# The 5-fold x 5-repeat results of the random forest and the 1D-CNN, and the three-level fully nested
# recheck of both in Appendix A3, were run on a remote server (random forest on CPU, 1D-CNN on GPU). The
# platform differs from that of the reference, so the fold-by-fold comparison is listed for these two
# methods without a verdict.
# Remote conda environment: Python 3.10.21, numpy 2.2.6, scipy 1.15.3, pandas 2.3.3, scikit-learn 1.7.2,
# joblib 1.6.0, torch 2.11.0+cu128 (CUDA 12.8, cuDNN 9.19); GPU: RTX 4090.
# Script 45 writes the environment of each result set (library versions; on GPU also the CUDA and cuDNN
# versions and the device model) to the manifest of that set (*_manifest.json; fields in ncv_manifest.py).
# Script 47 checks the environment recorded in each manifest. For PLSR, SVR, FPLR and FPCR it must equal
# the environment in which script 47 itself is run; for the random forest and the 1D-CNN it must equal the
# remote environment above, which script 47 holds as constants. The cache fingerprint in the manifest must
# equal the value expected for this round (for the methods run locally it is recomputed from the local
# data, grids and environment as script 45 defines it; for the random forest and the 1D-CNN it is the
# value written by the server shards). Script 47 recomputes all metrics of every fold from
# the reference values and the per-sample predictions with the formulas of script 45 and compares them
# with the summary rows. It also reads the grid cache written by script 45 to recompute the configuration
# selected in every fold and to compare the per-sample predictions (the caches of the random forest and
# the 1D-CNN were retrieved from the server).
